ci_support_linux_64_.yaml:
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma9
python_min:
- '3.10'

about.description:
VCF-RDFizer provides a Python CLI wrapper around a Dockerized VCF to RDF conversion pipeline.
It converts VCF files into RDF in the VCF Core vocabulary, optionally into compressed and
queryable representations (HDT, COTTAS), and can validate that the result still reproduces
the source VCF's semantics. It requires a working Docker installation at runtime for
conversion, compression, indexing and validation commands.
about.summary: Docker-first VCF to RDF conversion targeting the VCF Core vocabulary, with compressed queryable representations (HDT, COTTAS), semantic validation, and data linking

name: vcf-rdfizer
raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "vcf-rdfizer" %}
{% set version = "3.0.3" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/ecrum19/VCF-RDFizer/archive/refs/tags/v{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 25cdba9c63f1128fe0298f44de5897a1fffc8e0235b8f80ec7b26cd45e325cf0

build:
  noarch: python
  number: 0
  script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv
  entry_points:
    - vcf-rdfizer=vcf_rdfizer:main
    - vcf-rdfizer-rules=vcf_rdfizer_rules:main
    - vcf-rdfizer-link=vcf_rdfizer_link:main

requirements:
  host:
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - pip
    - setuptools >=77
    - wheel
  run:
    - python >={{ python_min }}
    - rich >=13.7.0
    - rdflib >=7.0.0

test:
  requires:
    - python {{ python_min }}
  commands:
    - vcf-rdfizer --help
    - vcf-rdfizer-rules --help
    - vcf-rdfizer-link list
  imports:
    - vcf_rdfizer
    # The vocabulary terms, VCF-version model and lexical parsers. Importing it
    # here catches a packaging miss that would otherwise only surface at
    # conversion time, since vcf_rdfizer imports it at module load.
    - vcf_rdfizer_vocab

about:
  home: https://github.com/ecrum19/VCF-RDFizer
  summary: Docker-first VCF to RDF conversion targeting the VCF Core vocabulary, with compressed queryable representations (HDT, COTTAS), semantic validation, and data linking
  license: MIT
  license_family: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  description: |
    VCF-RDFizer provides a Python CLI wrapper around a Dockerized VCF to RDF conversion pipeline.
    It converts VCF files into RDF in the VCF Core vocabulary, optionally into compressed and
    queryable representations (HDT, COTTAS), and can validate that the result still reproduces
    the source VCF's semantics. It requires a working Docker installation at runtime for
    conversion, compression, indexing and validation commands.
  doc_url: https://github.com/ecrum19/VCF-RDFizer/blob/main/README.md

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - ecrum19
